messages:
marta: heads up — deploy-bot just blocked the prod promotion from canary. see deploy-bot details below.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Release promotion blocked: mismatch detected between staging and prod for release 'canary-2026-03-20'. Issues: 1) KMS alias referenced by keystore.config -> kms_alias = 'alias/redwood-app-2026' exists in staging but missing in prod. 2) configmap 'router-config' key 'rate_limit_per_min' = '1200' in staging, '600' in prod. 3) image tag mismatch: staging uses redwood/runtime:1.13.0-rc, prod uses redwood/runtime:1.12.4. Promotion halted.

kevin: looking. quick confirm: is this from the canary->prod automated promotion or manual?

marta: automated canary promotion triggered after green canary. deploy-bot ran parity check during preflight and stopped.

kevin: ok digging into keystore. kubectl -n prod get secret keystore -o json | jq '.data' shows alias_ref not present. staging has alias_ref = alias/redwood-app-2026.

jia: who created that alias? I remember a small infra change last week for per-tenant KMS aliasing. might be the cause.

omar: I rotated some aliases during the maintenance window, but only in staging sandbox. I did not touch prod. my bad — I forgot to run the prod migration script.

sophia: can we do a hotfix to make prod fall back to the older alias? or do we back out the canary? we have a 60-minute change window for this release.

kevin: options: A) create alias in prod to match staging (quick, but needs approval and kms audit entries) B) change keystore config in prod to point to existing alias (risky for data isolation) C) revert canary promotion and re-run after proper migration.

marta: I'm leaning to revert promotion. We don't want a manual alias creation without audit/approve during a release.

sre-bot: [sre-bot] Note: creating alias in prod will require ServiceAccount 'infra-mgr' to have kms:CreateAlias and kms:PutKeyPolicy; change will trigger compliance alert and extend maintenance.

kevin: if we revert, we need to pin the runtime image on canary back to 1.12.4 to keep parity and avoid flapping. Also update release notes to call out migration requirement.

jia: agree. create a short rollback plan and a follow-up migration PR for prod alias creation with approvers: @marta, @sophia, @omar infra owner.

marta: action items: 1) @kevin — initiate rollback of canary promotion (pin image and un-promote) 2) @omar — schedule and run prod kms alias migration outside release window, add audit steps 3) @jia — draft release note blurb about alias migration + rate limit diff 4) @sophia — hold change window for next attempt and own approvals.

kevin: starting rollback now. running: deploy-bot rollback promote --release canary-2026-03-20 --reason "keystore KMS alias missing in prod"

sophia: thx. ping me when rollback completes and I'll coordinate a short change window for the migration.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback queued by kevin. Canaries will remain at staging image: redwood/runtime:1.13.0-rc. Prod stays on redwood/runtime:1.12.4.

kevin: rollback done — promotion reverted. logs:
```
INFO: promotion: revert start 2026-03-20T15:42:05Z
INFO: set prod deployment image=redwood/runtime:1.12.4
INFO: update route config to previous set
INFO: promotion: revert complete 2026-03-20T15:45:12Z
```

omar: I'll open the prod kms migration PR now and tag infra leads.

jia: drafting the release note snippet: "NOTE: Promotion deferred — prod KMS alias required for keystore not present. Infra migration scheduled; next attempt after alias audit and rate-limit parity check."

marta: add a line about temporary rate limit difference too.

jia: updated: "NOTE: Promotion deferred — prod KMS alias required for keystore not present. Also detected prod/staging rate limit mismatch (prod=600, staging=1200). Infra migration + config parity checks required before next promotion."

kevin: thanks. closing this thread once PR & change window are scheduled. :thumbsup:

sophia: I'll set a 2-hour change window tomorrow 09:00–11:00 PT and invite security for the alias creation sign-off.

marta: thanks team. we'll re-run the parity check once migration complete.

sre-bot: [sre-bot] Reminder: create a runbook entry for alias migration steps and rollback playbook for future parity failures.

kevin: noted. leaving thread
